correctness.rationale: For n≥1, f_n(0)=ξ_n is independent of the Wirtinger derivatives with squared magnitudes (n+1)X and nY. A zero is intensity-Palm selected, so the Kac–Rice mark is weighted by |U²−V²|, with E=(a²+b²)/(a+b); this is correctly distinguished from point conditioning. The singular values U+V and |U−V| give K=(U+V)/|U−V|. Changing to t=V/U yields density 4a²b² t|1−t²|/[E(b+at²)^3]; splitting t at one and substituting t↦1/t gives the displayed antiderivative, tail coefficient 32a²b²/[(a²+b²)(a+b)²], layer-cake moment threshold r<2, and the n→∞ survival 4k²/(k²+1)². Independent exact-rational antiderivative and k=100 checks n=1,2,5 approach the stated coefficients. No anisotropic scaling invariance claimed.
